flow_transcript_slices.question: Tell me a little about yourself and why early childhood education matters to you.
Why are you applying specifically to our company, Launch Pad Learning?
Tell me about a time a child was having a really hard moment emotionally. What did you notice about what they were feeling, and how did you respond?
Tell me about a time you felt overwhelmed at work with children present. What did you do to manage yourself?

Imagine you’re caring for a child who clearly does not want to be touched during a routine task, like diapering, helping with clothing, or guiding them physically. They are pulling away or saying no. Walk me through exactly what you would do, step by step
Tell me about a time you received feedback you didn’t expect or didn’t fully agree with. What happened next?
Tell me about a time something didn’t go as planned at work and your role in it. How did you handle the responsibility piece?
Tell me about a time you had to work closely with another adult in a challenging situation. How did you navigate it?
Can you share something you’ve learned about children or yourself over time that changed how you approach your work?
Tell me about how you physically care for infants or toddlers during routines like feeding, diapering, or comforting.
How do you understand what a nonverbal child needs when they’re crying or upset? Can you walk me through how you respond in those moments?
Are you looking for full-time or part-time?
Are there any hours you are absolutely not available to work? Do you have any preference, in terms of shift or schedule?
When could you start if we decide to move forward?
